title: Case manifest
description: One per case, in dataset/cases/<case_id>/manifest.json. Source paths are relative to the case directory, which mirrors the S3 prefix cases/<case_id>/. Enum values match shared/analysis.py (CasePriority, ContentType).

case_id.description: Must equal the case directory name, e.g. case-001.

heterogeneous.description: True when the case mixes text, image, audio and video or document sources.

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the case directory, e.g. chat/whatsapp.txt or media/IMG-0001.jpg. No leading slash, no '..'.

chat_format.description: Only for text sources that are chat exports (see docs/dataset.md).

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the naive timestamps in a chat export (default America/Costa_Rica).
